case_title: HUTSON DOUGLAS VS COHEN HOWARD DBA MAXFORD JEWELRY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY HUTSON DOUGLAS AS TO DEFENDANT COHEN HOWARD DBA MAXFORD JEWELRY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-10-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COHEN HOWARD DBA MAXFORD JEWELRY
THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HUTSON DOUGLAS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT COHEN HOWARD DBA MAXFORD JEWELRY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
